title: Canonical valid RegisterSession
purpose: Provide a canonical valid session-registration request as a stable baseline for subsequent stateful mutations.
expected_behavior: A compliant target should parse the 24-byte encapsulation header, accept the 4-byte RegisterSession payload, and allocate or return a session handle.
constraints_preserved: Length field is 0x0004 and matches the 4-byte command-specific payload.
Session handle is zero for initial registration.
Status is zero in the request.
Sender context is present as 8 bytes.
RegisterSession payload preserves protocol version 0x0001 and option flags 0x0000.
issue_safety_notes: This is a standard valid registration request and does not embed any issue-derived malformed state or payload relation.
